images.alt: Square photo of a family standing in shallow water at a beach, with children splashing and playing. An adult holds a small child while others watch nearby. A dark blue banner across the bottom reads: ‘Have your say: Consultation open until 18 May 2026’, with a QR code and ‘Scan me’ text. Below are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government and Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logos.

post.text:
Last chance to help shape the future of mental health and wellbeing in Aotearoa.

Consultation on the draft Mental Health and Wellbeing Strategy closes 5pm 18 May.

Don’t miss out - have your say (link in comments).
